subject: Service stability: throughput surge RCA & exec playbook
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine@rapidretail.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: ops+se@rapidretail.com
Date: 2027-08-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Immediate: sustained throughput spike -> 5xxs and token delays

Avery,

We're seeing a sustained throughput surge hitting our production inference jobs starting ~08:40 PDT. Error rate climbed to ~12% for 10 minutes and tail latencies (p95/p99) spiked to ~3.5s / 7.2s. This impacted our checkout completion flows — we've observed ~8% loss in successful completions during the window.

Our SRE already restarted a small subset of workers (no change). We can provide traces and a CSV of the request sampling. Can you open a priority bridge and loop in platform folks? RapidRetail needs an ETA on mitigation and whether warmed KV caches or fallback policies can be applied.

Attaching a small incident log for quick reference (rapid-retail-incident-log.csv).

Thanks,
Elaine
Ops Engineer, RapidRetail
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@rapidretail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-30T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Immediate: sustained throughput spike -> 5xxs and token delays

Thanks Elaine — we have the bridge starting now (redwood.me/bridge/9982).

Quick notes / ask:
- Karthik — please lead triage: confirm whether the spike correlates with a model roll or kernel change, and check routing/backpressure metrics.
- Marissa — I'll need you to coordinate comms and log the customer-visible impact (duration, affected endpoints).
- Jonas — flagging for exec attention given sustained 5xxs and customer checkout impact; will update with mitigation ETA.

Elaine, can you upload the request sample trace to the Drive link I just created (shared below)? Also confirm if RapidRetail enabled prefix caching on any route (that may change our fallback choices).

Bridge: redwood.me/bridge/9982
Drive (upload traces): https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aB3-rapidretail-rca

I'll summarize and push an interim action plan within 30 minutes.

—Avery
Senior Customer Reliability Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-30T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: RapidRetail incident — immediate mitigations & 24h playbook (internal)

Team,

Bridge notes and proposed short-term mitigations (summary):
- Symptom: throughput surge (unusual request envelope) -> elevated queueing -> increased evictions of KV cache entries -> higher per-request generation time -> cascading 5xx under burst.
- Immediate mitigations executed:
  • Throttled inbound rate for non-critical routes (applied by RapidRetail SRE) — reduced error rate to ~6% after 09:58.
  • Deployed temporary model variant w/ reduced precision for critical checkout route (canary on 5% of traffic).
  • Enabled aggressive KV cache preservation policy for pinned routes (manual override).

24h playbook (owners):
1) RCA deep-dive — Karthik to lead kernel/serving runtime correlation and validate if a recent kernel select change was pushed (owner: karthik_iyer — due: 2027-09-01 17:00 PDT).
2) Observability gaps — Marissa to compile missing traces and build a dashboard for tail latency (owner: marissa_cole — due: 2027-09-02 12:00 PDT).
3) Customer remediation comms — Avery to draft exec brief and proposed credits (owner: avery_johnson — initial draft due: 2027-08-30 16:00 PDT).
4) Long-term mitigations — Jonas to sponsor resource for KV cache persistence improvements and autoscaler tuning (owner: jonas_weber — target: Q4 roadmap).

Attachments: exec-brief.pptx (draft attached), rapid-retail-incident-log.csv (from customer).

Marissa
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-31T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RapidRetail incident — exec ask and credits decision

Good work triaging. A few exec-level asks:
1) Customer asks for a financial remediation proposal. Avery — please present a recommended credit and rationale. Keep it simple: metrics-based, tied to SLA windows and checkout success delta.
2) I want a one-page executive readout we can send to RapidRetail leadership by EOW. Marissa — use the exec-brief.pptx deck and strip to 1 slide + 1 pager.
3) Risk/roadmap funding: fast-track a small cross-functional spike to harden KV persistence and autoscaler safety limits. Karthik — prepare a 2-week scope and estimate for funding approval.

Related: HubSpot record HS-9982 is updated with preliminary impact numbers — include that in the readout.

If the remediation credit exceeds $25k, escalate to finance for approval. Otherwise we'll approve.

Jonas
VP, Customer Operations
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-07T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: RapidRetail post-incident delivery and action tracking (closure)

Team — closing the thread after posting the draft RCA and action tracker to the Drive. Status summary:
- RCA summary uploaded (postmortem-draft.pdf). Key finding: workload waveform + temporary kernel path selection caused KV churn under burst; autoscaler configured with optimistic cooldowns that allowed buildup.
- Actions logged (from earlier playbook):
  • Karthik — validation of kernel selection and a small rollback patch (completed 2027-09-05).
  • Marissa — observability dashboard created and shared (completed 2027-09-03).
  • Jonas — approved Q4 spike funding; engineering spike scheduled (start 2027-09-20).
  • Customer credit proposed: $18,500 (metrics-based, below finance escalation threshold).

Attachments: postmortem-draft.pdf (latest), exec-brief.pptx (1-slide readout).

Elaine / RapidRetail — sending to you now (cc'd) with the one-slide brief and the full draft RCA. Please confirm acceptance of the credit proposal and whether you'd like a synchronous readout with our CTO.

Closing notes: we'll maintain the action tracker in the shared Drive and close individual items as owners deliver. If anything needs reopening, reply-all and mark URGENT in the subject.

—Avery
Senior Customer Reliability Manager
Redwood Inference
